title: SAGE: Governed Artifact Generation from Enterprise Guidelines
abstract: arXiv:2609.17775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise guideline documents mix narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images, and converting them into structured work artifacts still takes two to three days of manual effort each. Current language and vision-language models extract from such documents but offer no governed workflow beyond extraction: no validation, no consistency checking, no traceable artifact generation. We introduce SAGE, a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline organized around a shared versioned rule store with stable identifiers, schema-validated inter-stage contracts, and end-to-end provenance tracking. Extracted rules undergo deterministic structural validation and LLM-based semantic scoring, then a consistency module that removes duplicates, flags contradictions, and surfaces specification gaps; only uncertain or flagged items reach reviewers, while high-confidence outputs are auto-approved. On 120 documents, SAGE cuts turnaround from days to 20-100 minut

translated_title: SAGE：基于企业指南的治理式工件生成
translated_abstract: 企业指南文档混合了叙述性文本、复杂表格和嵌入图像，将它们转换为结构化工作工件每份仍需两到三天的人工操作。当前的语言模型和视觉语言模型可以从这类文档中进行提取，但在提取之外没有提供治理性的工作流程：没有验证、没有一致性检查、也没有可追溯的工件生成。我们提出了SAGE，一个治理式的多阶段大语言模型流水线，它围绕一个带有稳定标识符的共享版本化规则库组织，具备经过模式验证的阶段间契约和端到端的来源追踪。提取的规则经过确定性的结构验证和基于大语言模型的语义评分，随后由一致性模块去除重复项、标记矛盾之处并揭示规范缺口；只有不确定或被标记的项目才会送交审核人员，而高置信度的输出则会自动批准。在120份文档上，SAGE将周转时间从数天缩短至20-100分钟……
tldr: SAGE提出一个治理式的多阶段大语言模型流水线，通过共享版本化规则库、结构验证、语义评分和一致性检查，将企业指南文档转化为结构化工件的周期从数天缩短到分钟级，且仅将不确定项交由人工审核。
en_tdlr: SAGE introduces a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline built on a shared versioned rule store with structural validation, semantic scoring, and consistency checking, cutting enterprise guideline-to-artifact conversion from days to minutes while routing only uncertain items to human reviewers.
